verdict.rationale: Nitrokey is a hardware security key covering FIDO2, OTP, OpenPGP, PIV and HSM functions. Scheduling recurring jobs or workflows is outside that product category. Nothing in the evidence shows the device or its nitropy CLI offering any scheduling capability, and running nitropy from a host scheduler would be a host-platform workaround, not a Nitrokey feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
